Retained rows require a lowercase 64-byte SHA-256, trimmed bounded reason, sorted unique nonempty canonical semantic targets, preserve true, and physical_deletion_authorized false. Only HCT-, PS-, SKILL:, AGENT:, COMMAND:, and CONTRACT-REGISTRY: target grammars are accepted.

A valid retained output is read as a confined regular file, digest-bound, and emitted as Context/ContextOnly with registry provenance, no generator, and replacement references.
